resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Canada Lookouts listing (53.353, 125.268) and the Wikipedia summit position (53.35278, 125.27000) differ by about 135 m, which is within the rounding and listing precision. The brief's own coordinates (53.35262, -125.27013) sit closer to the Wikipedia position. The link between the lookout and Mount Swannell is inferred from name and location, not stated by a source.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The only lookout-specific source is a Canada Lookouts entry giving name, region, coordinates and elevation. No source found gives build date, staffing, fire history, status or access. The Wikipedia article is about the mountain and does not mention a lookout. The lookout-to-mountain link is an inference from name and position. The listing's elevation (1815) has no unit; it is stored as elevation_m on the reading that it is metres, which fits the 1821 m summit height, but this is inferred. The story is about 150 words, which is short of the usual minimum because the evidence has nothing further. The brief's catalogue link (BC Data Catalogue dataset d1fc9c40-c3ba-4ae4-ae5a-838ad3c43289) is a legacy GeoBC base-map record (Landmark Structures, TRIM Enhanced Base Map) that lists fire lookout towers as a generic category. It is not a lookout register, so it is not cited. Brief access and status 'unknown' are left unfilled, because no source supports a value.
